legacy-hosted.notes: Hosted tables with tenant_id/workspace_id/user_id require an explicit host-owned rebuild; the portable pack never guesses account ownership.

recovery.storage: value-free input/output key lists plus redacted errors

notes: Portable hook definitions use opaque owner_id plus scope_type/scope_ref instead of tenant/workspace columns. Code and config hooks share the event and receipt contracts but do not need to be materialized as definition rows. Secrets remain runtime-owned references.
